name: Cauldron Ceramic Mug
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality ceramic for a solid, durable, and sturdy feel.
    - Features a glossy finished surface that gives the mug a smooth and polished appearance.
    - Designed in a unique cauldron-inspired shape, adding a fun and eye-catching decorative touch.
    - Built with a thick ceramic body to help maintain structure during everyday use.
    - Comes with a sturdy handle for a comfortable and secure grip.
    - The four-legged base enhances stability while adding a whimsical cauldron look.
    - Suitable for both functional daily use and seasonal decorative display.
    - - Available in 2 classic colors: Black and Purple.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Top diameter: 3.3 in ~ 8.38 cm
    - Height: 3.74 in ~ 9.5 cm
    - Overall width: 5.3 in ~ 13.46 cm
    - Capacity: 13 oz
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Supports one-sided printing or double-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Suitable for serving coffee, tea, hot chocolate, milk, and other favorite beverages.
    - The sturdy handle provides a comfortable grip for everyday drinking.
    - The rounded cauldron shape offers a fun and distinctive presentation, especially for themed collections.
    - The four-legged base helps the mug stand steadily on flat surfaces.
    - Ideal for seasonal drinkware, especially Halloween-themed kitchen or desk setups.
    - Can be used as both a functional mug and a decorative display piece.
    - Great for home, office, coffee corners, party tables, and festive décor arrangements.
    - A fun addition to mug collections, themed kitchenware, and personalized gift sets.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for Halloween lovers and spooky-themed gift collections.
    - Great for friends, family members, coworkers, teachers, and mug collectors.
    - A fun gift choice for Halloween parties, birthdays, holiday gifts, and seasonal celebrations.
    - Suitable for personalized gifts with names, quotes, festive artwork, or themed designs.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys unique mugs, seasonal home décor, and novelty drinkware.
    - A thoughtful option for gifting as both a practical item and a cute decorative keepsake.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Cauldron Ceramic Mug

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
